mapper.select: SELECT id,file_name AS fileName,file_url AS fileUrl,file_type AS fileType,attachment_type AS attachmentType,parse_status AS parseStatus,parse_error AS parseError,position_count AS positionCount,parsed_at AS parsedAt,source_text AS sourceText,created_at AS createdAt FROM recruitment_attachment WHERE notice_id=#{noticeId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id,notice_id AS noticeId,file_name AS fileName,file_url AS fileUrl,file_type AS fileType,attachment_type AS attachmentType,parse_status AS parseStatus FROM recruitment_attachment WHERE notice_id=#{noticeId} AND attachment_type='POSITION_DATA' ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recruitment_attachment(notice_id,file_name,file_url,dedupe_key,file_type,attachment_type,source_text,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{noticeId},#{fileName},#{fileUrl},#{dedupeKey},#{fileType},#{attachmentType},#{sourceText},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE file_name=VALUES(file_name),file_type=VALUES(file_type),attachment_type=VALUES(attachment_type),source_text=VALUES(source_text),updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
